_comment: Ratchet baseline for check_no_app_names.py. These counts may only go DOWN. The target for all four is zero: content reaches it at extraction (stage 7), imports at the AppSpec seams (stage 4), home_path_sites when every path in $HOME comes from config. `watched` is sticky on purpose, so an app that leaves the catalog is still scanned for leftovers. NOTE 2026-08-27: content/imports/literals were re-pinned at a HIGHER measured value on this date, once, because the scan area was widened from six directories to the tracked tree and an app-content file stopped short-circuiting out of all four checks. Nobody added those lines; the gate could not previously see them. See `raised` below for the full reason, which prints on every run until each count comes back down.

content_files.because: STAGE E, SECOND HALF (2026-09-02): the FRONTEND app registry no longer enumerates apps either. frontend/src/apps/registry.tsx held a literal APPS array with every app's routes, crumbs, icon, provider and launcher probe, and called itself 'the ONE file allowed to name a specific app'. Each app now declares itself in frontend/src/pages/apps/<app>/module.tsx exporting appModule, and the registry finds them with import.meta.glob, which Vite still resolves statically so code-splitting is unchanged. The contract is apps/appModule.ts (types) and apps/appShell.tsx (AppGroupNav + makeChatDock). content_files 114 -> 121 is exactly the seven new app-owned module.tsx files, buying literal_sites 408 -> 354 and import_sites 18 -> 17. Both registries -- backend and frontend -- now contain ZERO app names, as do apps/appModule.ts, apps/appShell.tsx and pages/Memory.tsx (which imported the notes app's id to build a legacy redirect; the app declares that via AppModule.legacyTabs now). What remains is EXTRACTION: moving the app source itself out of this repo, which is section 10 of app-is-the-entity-2026-08-20.md and needs the operator's repo decision.
